title: How Many Queens to BEAT Martin?
summary: King plus one queen vs Martin's full army (first of the piece-series), adding a queen per failed game. Qd4 centralised, he hopes for blunders on long diagonals; the first attempt ends in a threefold-repetition draw, then on retry he picks off Martin's pieces one by one and delivers a 'pure ladder mate' with king fence + queen - won with just one queen.
rules: Player (White): king + N queens; Martin: full army.
Start N=1; add a queen after a failed game (a draw counts as failed).
Normal chess rules incl. threefold repetition.

board.theme_notes: chess.com brown board with eval bar at side.
